Data extraction: PSV (pipe-separated values) rows as Sequence nodes

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"data_extraction\":true,\"language\":\"psv\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "a|b|c\n1|2|3\n", config: configObj)
debugPrint(result.data() as Any)
debugPrint(result.data()?.kind() as Any)
debugPrint(result.data()?.children() as Any)
```
